pages.title: Ephemeral Quark Ore
pages.text: Quarks borrowed from the vacuum and caught before they could be returned. They glow in shifting red, green and blue, colour charge that never settles, and the vein flickers as pairs pop into being and vanish. Leave it alone and it seems to breathe.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In foam substrate I saw sparks that lasted only an instant, virtual quark pairs living on borrowed energy. One seam held them a little longer than the uncertainty principle should allow, long enough to mine.
$(thing)Found$(): in veins through the Quantum Foam (mine it for its drop).
